mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_object_application_grant WHERE object_id = #{object} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY application_id
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_object_application_grant WHERE application_id = #{app} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY object_id
SELECT id::text AS id, app_name AS name FROM public.nocode_application WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY app_name, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_object_application_grant(object_id, application_id, lock_version, grant_json, reason, creator, updater) VALUES (#{object}, #{app}, 1, CAST(#{json} AS jsonb), #{reason}, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT(object_id, application_id) DO UPDATE SET grant_json = EXCLUDED.grant_json, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, lock_version = nocode_object_application_grant.lock_version + 1, updater = #{actor}, update_time = clock_timestamp()
